name: Lipschitz Proxy Nodes
definition: A proxy node C that generates a 1-Lipschitz signed distance field by interpolating between the original field f and a volume distance field v over an interpolation region $\Omega$, ensuring continuity.
summary: Lipschitz Proxy Nodes replace complex SDF sub-trees with continuous proxy fields, ensuring global 1-Lipschitz continuity for compatibility with smooth Boolean operators.
